entities.name: Piotr Müller
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Piotr Józef Müller is a Polish politician and lawyer, Undersecretary of State (2018) and Secretary of State (2019) at the Ministry of Science and Higher Education, member of the Standing Committee of the Council of Ministers, Deputy to the 8th and 9th term Sejm, government spokesman and Secretary of State at the Chancellery of the Prime Minister of Poland (2019-2023). He has been a Member of the European Parliament from Poland since July 2024.
